name: Example Coffee Shop

audiences.name: Neighbors within a 15-minute walk: remote workers, students and retirees who like a calm place to spend a morning
audiences.pain: Chain cafes feel rushed and impersonal; they want good coffee and a place where they are recognized

audiences.name: Weekend visitors and families looking for a relaxed brunch spot nearby
audiences.pain: Brunch places are crowded, noisy or overpriced

pillars: Behind the bar: our coffee and the people who make it
Fresh from the oven: daily pastries and brunch
Neighborhood life: events, local suppliers and regulars
notes: Fictional example brand that ships with the repo. Bilingual: post in Spanish by default, in English when the post targets visitors or tourists.

visual.style: Warm, natural-light photography with a handmade, slightly rustic feel; lots of wood, ceramic and steam
visual.imagery: Real cups, pastries and hands at work; morning light through the window; close-ups of textures
visual.avoid: Stock-photo smiles, neon colors, plastic cups, heavy filters, busy backgrounds
